title: Crude stocks fell again, but the latest draw slowed
question: Did the latest weekly draw intensify, or did it slow after the preceding decline?
comparability_limits: U.S. commercial crude stocks excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve; not global oil supply, end-user demand, or a price series.
EIA release dated October 21, 2026; final observation is the week ending October 16. This is not a new October 24/25 release.
Captured vintage only; no revision history or market-expectations series supplied.
Changes are deterministic current-minus-previous differences from the same original EIA stock series, not separately reported demand figures or forecast surprises.
Three weekly changes describe this short interval; they do not establish a persistent tightening regime or isolate the driver of any futures-price movement.
